freshFunctionalContracts.topic: One-stop entry points, installation, account setup/reset and control/config/application updates

freshFunctionalContracts.topic: Root authorization, actual execution identity and project creation

freshFunctionalContracts.topic: Transaction journals, retained service definitions and reversible candidate capacity
freshFunctionalContracts.checks: Trusted recorded bindings and barriers; strict ordinary verify versus exact recorded legacy restoration; shared management lock modes without relaxing initialization; archive complete three-probe evidence, unmounted/stopped proof, capacity eight and no deletion shortcut.

freshFunctionalContracts.topic: Managed proxy core/configuration/routing and compensating lifecycle
freshFunctionalContracts.checks: Official immutable core/asset verification, private selection, total network deadlines, per-chain rule order, PID1-maintained cgroup set and fixed worker/gateway/management scope, checked core/config startup, listener readiness and upstream verification; candidate activation/rollback preserve root policy, data, old assets and journals.

Legacy registry migration, multiple connections, disabled-provider credential redaction/protection, Zhipu empty default discovery, official/native/catalog read paths, exact layers and durable receipts with safe unknown/recovery classification.

Current HTTP/DNS/import modes, staging/active certificate transaction, precise trust/SNI/instance checks, cancellation/compensation, pinned Caddy DNS build; backup/restore includes exact instance proxy core root and both optional role barriers. Go pins and unchanged test interiors inherit prior audit, no compilation.

freshFunctionalContracts.topic: Workspace helper and accepted-result witness boundaries
freshFunctionalContracts.checks: Actual native identity, root/path restrictions, serialized helper receipts, before-send ownership, durable positive receipt, acknowledgement cleanup after caller proof, retained unknown effects and no resend after helper success.

method.helperAckCompatibility: The helper saves a completed positive mutation record before returning success. RuntimeWorkspace now records acknowledged before local witness completion; downstream rejection after that acknowledgement remains unknown, keeps the witness and does not resend. Definite pre-dispatch rejection can discard only not_sent. This is consistent with helper dispatched/error semantics; the referenced runtime files are outside this 138-file ownership partition.
unexecutedIntegrations: No tests, builds, paid model/MCP calls, certificate issuance, service changes, full suite or online deployment were executed for this audit.
Historical root/native/systemd/proxy probes remain bound to their original reports and sources; they were not rerun.

A separate deployment-preparation task performed one narrow read-only endpoint/hash comparison, not a repeated online audit/preflight. Its ignored wrapper findings and closure remain separate from production source findings.
